name: Saint Neophytos Enkleistra
scope: The Enkleistra at Agios Neophytos Monastery, specifically the cliffside hermitage, cell and chapel exterior, high terrace, diagonal stair and immediate ravine crossing as photographed in 1888.
era: The state of the surviving historic hermitage observed by Hogarth during his 1888 journey and published in 1889.

originalReview.notes: The original 1889 London title page dates the archaeological journey to 1888. The image facing page 22 is credited to Hogarth and shows the cell and chapel, the cliff, the terrace facade and the stone approach.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Checked the published Qualla photos first. The available building photos carry attribution and share-alike terms. Used Hogarth’s original published 1888 photograph for the historically dated Enkleistra.
